subject: Quantify AI — retainer/packaging request & exec clearance
messages:
From: Amelia Ross <amelia.ross@quantify.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@quantify.ai
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood proposal follow-up — purchasing constraints

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our execs liked Redwood's latency profile and the batching/caching promises, but we're still constrained on spend for calendar 2027. To make a program work we need to get to a lower unit price — effectively a 55–60% discount off list for a 24-month commitment with a minimum monthly retainer.

Concretely:
- 24 month term
- $40k/mo committed retainer (billed monthly)
- Standard support; optional SAML + on-boarding add-on

If Redwood can provide pricing in that range we can move forward quickly and I can pull procurement signatures. If not, we may need to table until Q4.

Attached is our RFP response for reference (Quantify_RFP-response-v3.pdf).

Can you confirm whether this packaging is something you can escalate for VP/CFO approval?

Thanks,
Amelia
Amelia Ross
Head of Data Products, Quantify AI
amelia.ross@quantify.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Redwood proposal follow-up — purchasing constraints

Marissa / Vivek — forwarding Quantify's ask. They want a deep retainer discount (55–60%) for a 24-mo commitment at $40k/mo. They say procurement is ready to sign if we can reach that unit economics.

Why I think we should consider an exception:
- Strategic use-case (real-time inference across 50M monthly events) — could become high-volume paid customer in 2028.
- They will allow a publicly listed case study if we hit delivery SLAs.
- Committed retainer smooths revenue and reduces churn risk.

Suggested guardrails for an exception:
- 24-month term with 12-month minimum commitment clause and step-up pricing in year 2 (e.g., +15% on year-2 list)
- Require 6-month notice for cancellations and an early-termination fee (ETF) covering remaining committed months at a fixed blended rate
- KPI-based credits only up to 10% of monthly retainer (no open-ended credits)

I've drafted a short exception memo and attached the Quantify RFP. Can you review and advise if we can route to finance/exec sign-off? Attachment: exception_memo_for_exec_signoff.pdf

Thanks,
Grace
Grace O'Connor
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 14:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Redwood proposal follow-up — purchasing constraints

Grace / Vivek — thanks for the context and the memo. I reviewed Quantify's RFP and your proposed guardrails. A few notes from finance perspective:

Key concerns:
- 55–60% off list for a first-year baseline is outside our standard authorization matrix for AEs and requires VP + CFO sign-off (so route is correct).
- Risk on usage overage revenue — if their usage spikes we'll end up delivering at a very low blended price unless we enforce strong overage tiers or volume tiers.

Proposed commercial revisions to include on the memo:
1) Tiered usage schedule: keep the $40k/mo as committed retainer (covers up to X tokens/requests). Overage priced at a higher per-token rate until negotiated step thresholds are hit.
2) Year-2 step-up: instead of a flat +15%, set a volume-contingent step-up (e.g., +10% if usage <1.5x committed, +20% if usage >1.5x).
3) Cap total discount in year-1 to a maximum realized discount of 50% after taking into account onboarding credits and credits for failed SLAs.
4) Require a pre-signed amendment for any integration/feature work that is not in the SOW (billable separately).

Please update the memo with these clauses. Also attach a committed-forecast workbook (Quantify_committed-forecast.xlsx) showing expected usage profile — that will help finance model worst-case blended ARPU.

If we agree on revised memo, I can pull the CFO in for a quick read and sign. For transparency: if we do approve, I will ask for a counterparty finance guarantee (bank reference or purchase order) given the size and term.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 09:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Redwood proposal follow-up — purchasing constraints

Thanks Marissa — incorporated your clauses into the memo and added the tiered overage schedule. I also attached the Quantify committed forecast workbook they provided and annotated the forecast assumptions. Attachment: Quantify_committed-forecast.xlsx

Summary of changes made to the exception_memo_for_exec_signoff.pdf:
- Added tiered overage pricing and explicit thresholds
- Replaced flat year-2 increase with volume-contingent step-up bands
- Added max realized discount cap (50%) and SLA credit ceiling
- Inserted language requiring PO or bank reference as part of approval

Can you confirm if this wording is sufficient for you to take to CFO? If yes, I'll prepare the executive sign-off packet and route to Vivek for VP approval prior to CFO.

Also pinging Vivek to confirm VP-side comfort with the structure — we want to avoid last-minute pushback.

Grace
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2027 15:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Redwood proposal follow-up — purchasing constraints

Thanks team — reviewed the updated memo and forecast. I support routing this to CFO for final sign-off with the following explicit approvals/conditions:

- Approve exception to standard list pricing subject to:
  * 24-month term with a 12-month minimum enforceable commitment
  * Max realized first-year discount capped at 50% as redlined
  * Tiered overage schedule and volume-contingent year-2 step-ups included
  * Require PO or bank reference and a signed SOW for any professional services

- I will sign the VP approval block on the exception memo once Marissa confirms CFO is available for a brief review call (15–20 min).

Grace — please bundle the exception memo, forecast workbook, and the Quantify RFP into a single executive packet (PDF) and share the HubSpot deal link in the DocuSign request. Marissa — please confirm availability for a quick CFO sync; if not available tomorrow, we can seek CFO asynchronous sign in DocuSign.

Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Commercial Sales, Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
